steps: Score the bottom of the tomatoes crosswise and place in a large bowl. Pour boiling or hot water over it. After 10 minutes, carefully remove the skin and the green button on the top of the tomato and chop the peeled tomatoes into small pieces.
Now dice the onions small and press the garlic. Fry both in olive oil and after about 3 minutes add the tomato pieces.
After a few minutes, add the vegetable stock and spices (without the parsley) and cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and puree the soup finely with a hand blender.
Season with spices as desired and serve with a little fresh parsley.
